title: Add read-only adopt-project command for mature Kajiya repositories
problem: Kajiya Build Line can initialize fresh repositories, but mature repositories like kajiya-context-engine already have docs/state/current-project.json, docs/state/backlog.json, docs/LLM_HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md, schema directories, scenario directories, pi.dev governance docs, and project-specific handoff doctrine. Running init-project is not the right flow for these repos.
expected_behavior: A read-only adopt-project command inspects the current repository, detects existing Kajiya-compatible artifacts, reports missing Build Line artifacts, warns when init-project should not be used, and returns a JSON-compatible adoption plan without modifying files.
proposed_change: Inspect only the current working directory using Path.cwd().
Classify repository as fresh_repo, already_initialized, mature_kajiya_repo, partial_kajiya_repo, or incompatible_repo.
Return do_not_run_init_project when mature project files already exist.
Return missing recommended artifacts and adoption_plan.
Do not create, modify, or delete files.
close_criteria: Command detects mature Kajiya repository artifacts.
Command reports AGENTS.md missing when absent.
Command reports do_not_run_init_project for mature repos.
